Anything left as "" or [] hides itself — an empty family list removes the Family section and its menu link.
weddingDate must be ISO: "2026-12-12". weddingTime is free text: "7:00 PM onwards" (a clock time in it feeds the countdown).
rsvp.type is one of: whatsapp | form | url | none. For whatsapp, value is the number with country code and no +, e.g. "919876543210".
Photos go in public/images/ and are referenced as "/images/name.jpg". Music goes in public/music/.
Any image you leave out is replaced by generated gold artwork, so a half-filled file still looks finished.

story.title: How we met
story.body: A mutual friend's birthday dinner, a long argument about the best biryani in the city, and a conversation that simply never ended. Neither of us won the argument.

story.title: The promise
story.body: A quiet yes on a terrace at sunset, said in front of the people who matter most to us — and then a phone call to every relative before the tea had gone cold.

timeline.title: Mehendi
timeline.description: Henna, music and the slow, happy hum of the house filling up with family.

timeline.title: Haldi
timeline.description: Marigolds, turmeric and blessings — the morning everything turns golden.

timeline.title: Sangeet
timeline.description: An evening of rehearsed dances, unrehearsed laughter and far too many encores.

timeline.title: Baraat
timeline.description: The procession arrives — dhol, flowers and a street that belongs to us.

timeline.title: The Wedding
timeline.description: Vows exchanged before the sacred fire, witnessed by everyone we love.

timeline.title: Reception
timeline.description: Dinner, toasts and the first evening as husband and wife.
